name: claude-init
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace by bkirosangma

plugins.name: workdir
plugins.description: Initialize and maintain a multi-repo workspace with compound intelligence (graphify + claude-mem + MEMORY.md), workspace-scoped gitconfig, ignore files, knowledge vault, coding standards, claude-mem worker, ui-ux-pro-max skill, group-organized repo cloning with host detection, idempotent re-init via per-step probes, version-tracked manifest with changelog diff on update, and portable MEMORY.md seed bootstrap.

plugins.name: knowledge-base
plugins.description: Unified skill for managing knowledge-base vaults — architecture docs, design diagrams, ADRs, runbooks, plus music-domain features (SVG notation, guitar tabs, music archetype). Sub-commands: init, document, diagram, create, edit, svg, guitar-tabs, validate, transform. Trigger: /knowledge-base or /kb.

plugins.name: hybrid-search
plugins.description: Fused search across claude-mem (temporal) and graphify (structural) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Auto-injects graph neighbours + MEMORY.md entries on Read via PreToolUse hook. Ships the auto-rebuild-graph, crystallize, contradiction-check, decay, and proceduralize hook scripts that wire compound intelligence together.

plugins.name: compound-dispatch
plugins.description: Enriches subagent prompts with 'Prior Knowledge' from all three memory systems — graphify (structural), claude-mem (temporal), MEMORY.md (curated) — before dispatching them. Bridges the gap where subagents normally start with blank context.
